description: Election Commission - Appointed Kahingalage Chandrawathee as the member of the Rajgama Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Rajgama Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's resignation, as governed by the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of a new member by a political party, which falls under election-related matters.
